arxiv-2101-02577.title: Robust and Attack Resilient Logic Locking with a High Application-Level Impact Journal: JETC Volume: 1 1 1 1 Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3446215 CCS: Security and privacy Security in hardware
arxiv-2101-02577.creator: Yuntao Liu, Michael Zuzak, Yang Xie, Abhishek Chakraborty, Ankur Srivastava
arxiv-2101-02577.description: Abstract . Logic locking is a hardware security technique aimed at protecting intellectual property (IP) against security threats in the IC supply chain, especially those posed by untrusted fabrication facilities. Such techniques incorporate additional locking circuitry within an IC that induces incorrect digital functionality when an incorrect verification key is provided by a user.

arxiv-2108-05520.title: Dereverberation of Autoregressive Envelopes for Far-field Speech Recognition Journal: Computer Speech and Language Special Issue
arxiv-2108-05520.creator: Anurenjan Purushothaman, Anirudh Sreeram, Rohit Kumar, Sriram Ganapathy
arxiv-2108-05520.description: Abstract The task of speech recognition in far-field environments is adversely affected by the reverberant artifacts that elicit as the temporal smearing of the sub-band envelopes. In this paper, we develop a neural model for speech dereverberation using the long-term sub-band envelopes of speech.

arxiv-2201-11404.title: Online Planning in POMDPs with Self-Improving Simulators
arxiv-2201-11404.creator: Jinke He, Miguel Suau, Hendrik Baier, Michael Kaisers, Frans A. Oliehoek
arxiv-2201-11404.description: Abstract How can we plan efficiently in a large and complex environment when the time budget is limited? Given the original simulator of the environment, which may be computationally very demanding, we propose to learn online an approximate but much faster simulator that improves over time.

arxiv-2204-06489.title: Iterative PDE-constrained optimization for seismic full-waveform inversion
arxiv-2204-06489.creator: Mikhail Malovichko, Akbar Orazbayev, Nikolay Khokhlov
arxiv-2204-06489.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel numerical method for the Newton seismic full-waveform inversion (FWI). The method is based on the full-space approach, where the state, adjoint state, and control variables are optimized simultaneously. Each Newton step is formulated as a PDE-constrained optimization problem, which is cast in the form of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) system of linear algebraic equitations.

arxiv-2305-10136.title: Additive manifesto decomposition: A policy domain aware method for understanding party positioning
arxiv-2305-10136.creator: Tanise Ceron, Dmitry Nikolaev, Sebastian Padó
arxiv-2305-10136.description: Abstract Automatic extraction of party (dis)similarities from texts such as party election manifestos or parliamentary speeches plays an increasing role in computational political science. However, existing approaches are fundamentally limited to targeting only global party (dis)similarity: they condense the relationship between a pair of parties into a single figure, their similarity. In aggregating over all policy domains (e.g.

arxiv-2310-08070.title: Tight Time-Space Lower Bounds for Constant-Pass Learning
arxiv-2310-08070.creator: Xin Lyu, Avishay Tal, Hongxun Wu, Junzhao Yang
arxiv-2310-08070.description: Abstract In his breakthrough paper, Raz showed that any parity learning algorithm requires either quadratic memory or an exponential number of samples [FOCS’16, JACM’19]. A line of work that followed extended this result to a large class of learning problems.

arxiv-2311-07841.title: PEMs: Pre-trained Epidemic Time-Series Models
arxiv-2311-07841.creator: Harshavardhan Kamarthi, B. Aditya Prakash
arxiv-2311-07841.description: Abstract Providing accurate and reliable predictions about the future of an epidemic is an important problem for enabling informed public health decisions. Recent works have shown that leveraging data-driven solutions that utilize advances in deep learning methods to learn from past data of an epidemic often outperform traditional mechanistic models.

arxiv-2404-10725.title: Hilbert space delocalization under random unitary circuits
arxiv-2404-10725.creator: Xhek Turkeshi, Piotr Sierant
arxiv-2404-10725.description: Abstract Unitary dynamics of a quantum system initialized in a selected basis state yields, generically, a state that is a superposition of all the basis states. This process, associated with the quantum information scrambling and intimately tied to the resource theory of coherence, may be viewed as a gradual delocalization of the system’s state in the Hilbert space.

arxiv-2404-14668.title: Source Localization for Cross Network Information Diffusion
arxiv-2404-14668.creator: Chen Ling, Tanmoy Chowdhury, Jie Ji, Sirui Li, Andreas Züfle, Liang Zhao
arxiv-2404-14668.description: Abstract . Source localization aims to locate information diffusion sources only given the diffusion observation, which has attracted extensive attention in the past few years. Existing methods are mostly tailored for single networks and may not be generalized to handle more complex networks like cross-networks. Cross-network is defined as two interconnected networks, where one network’s functionality depends on the other.

arxiv-2407-07753.title: Quantum CSS Duadic and Triadic Codes: New Insights and Properties
arxiv-2407-07753.creator: Reza Dastbasteh ✉, Olatz Sanz Larrarte, Josu Etxezarreta Martinez, Antonio deMarti iOlius, Javier Oliva del Moral, Pedro Crespo Bofill
arxiv-2407-07753.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the construction of quantum CSS duadic codes with dimensions greater than one. We introduce a method for extending smaller splittings of quantum duadic codes to create larger, potentially degenerate quantum duadic codes. Furthermore, we present a technique for computing or bounding the minimum distances of quantum codes constructed through this approach.

arxiv-2505-16037.title: Causal LLM Routing: End-to-End Regret Minimization from Observational Data
arxiv-2505-16037.creator: Asterios Tsiourvas, Wei Sun, Georgia Perakis
arxiv-2505-16037.description: Abstract LLM routing aims to select the most appropriate model for each query, balancing competing performance metrics such as accuracy and cost across a pool of language models. Prior approaches typically adopt a decoupled strategy, where metrics are first predicted and the model is then selected based on these estimates.

arxiv-2508-14377.title: ZPD-SCA : Unveiling the Blind Spots of LLMs in Assessing Students’ Cognitive Abilities Thanks: Corresponding author ( xinleihe@hkust-gz.edu.cn , molei@m.scnu.edu.cn )
arxiv-2508-14377.creator: Wenhan Dong Zhen Sun Yuemeng Zhao Zifan Peng, Yu Wang Ruiming Wang Xinyi Huang Lei Mo
arxiv-2508-14377.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in educational applications, yet their capacity to accurately assess the cognitive alignment of reading materials with students’ developmental stages remains insufficiently explored. This gap is particularly critical given the foundational educational principle of the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD), which emphasizes the need to match learning resources with Students’ Cognitive Abilities (SCA).

arxiv-2509-18071.title: Learning functions, operators and dynamical systems with kernels
arxiv-2509-18071.creator: Lorenzo Rosasco
arxiv-2509-18071.description: Abstract This expository article presents the approach to statistical machine learning based on reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. The basic framework is introduced for scalar-valued learning and then extended to operator learning. Finally, learning dynamical systems is formulated as a suitable operator learning problem, leveraging Koopman operator theory.

arxiv-2511-06509.title: A mathematical framework of consumer–resource dynamics: How to incorporate interactions between interactions in evolutionary process
arxiv-2511-06509.creator: Alexander S. Bratus, Sergei V. Drozhzhin , Artem S. Novozhilov, [3mm] ​ 1 {\emph{1}} Marchuk Institute of Numerical Mathematics, Russian Academy of Sciences, 119333, Russia, [0mm] ​ 2 {\emph{2}} Moscow Center of Fundamental and Applied Mathematics, 119991, Russia, [0mm] ​ 3 {\emph{3}} Institute of M
arxiv-2511-06509.description: Abstract A novel mathematical framework is proposed to describe the ecological and evolutionary consequences of consumer–resource interactions. Both the consumer and resource are assumed to consist of several (sub)species, which interact between themselves in addition to incorporating the deleterious effects of the consumer on the resource.

arxiv-2602-12671.title: Structures and comodules of Hom-post Lie coalgebras
arxiv-2602-12671.creator: Houndedji Damien
arxiv-2602-12671.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the notions of Hom-tridendriform coalgebras and Hom-post-Lie coalgebras as the dual notions of Hom-tridendriform algebras and Hom-post-LIe algebras respectively. We give some properties realted to them. Then, we study the relationships between them and their connection with post-Hom-Poisson coalgebras.

arxiv-2602-20278.title: Exponential Lower Bounds for 2-query Relaxed Locally Decodable Codes Thanks: An extended abstract of this paper appeared in the Proceedings of the 38th Computational Complexity Conference, 2023 [ BBC+23 ] .
arxiv-2602-20278.creator: Alexander R. Block, Jeremiah Blocki, Kuan Cheng, Elena Grigorescu, Xin Li, Yu Zheng, Minshen Zhu
arxiv-2602-20278.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Alexander R. Block, Jeremiah Blocki, Kuan Cheng, Elena Grigorescu, Xin Li, Yu Zheng, Minshen Zhu. Locally Decodable Codes (LDCs) are error-correcting codes C : Σ n → Σ m , C\colon\Sigma^{n}\rightarrow\Sigma^{m}, encoding messages in Σ n \Sigma^{n} to codewords in Σ m \Sigma^{m} , with super-fast decoding algorithms.

arxiv-2603-26916.title: Mitigating Resampling Artifacts for the JWST IFU Spectrometers with Adaptive Trace Modeling
arxiv-2603-26916.creator: David R. Law, Melanie Clarke

arxiv-2606-21497.title: Breaking chains with trees: Deep learning with 𝒪 ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(\log N) parallel time complexity
arxiv-2606-21497.creator: Neeraj Mohan Sushma, Aditya Nagarsekar, Cabrel Teguemne Fokam, Robin Schiewer, Amit Kumar Pal, Anand Subramoney, David Kappel, [3ex] Center for Cognitive Interaction Technology, Bielefeld University, Germany {neeraj.sushma, robin.schiewer, amit.pal, david.kappel}@uni-bielefeld.de, [1ex] Ruhr Universität Bochum, Germany, [1ex] Birla Institute of Technology, Science, Pilani, Goa Campus, [1ex] Royal Holloway, University of London, UK anand.subramoney@rhul.ac.uk

britannica-1911-wharton-francis.title: Wharton, Francis (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-wharton-francis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-wharton-francis.description: Article 'Wharton, Francis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. and educationalist, was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on the 7th of March 1820. He graduated at Yale in 1839, was admitted to the bar in 1843, became prominent in Pennsylvania politics as a Democrat, and in Philadelphia edited the North A merican and United States Gazette. He was professor of English history and literature at Kenyon College, Gambler, Ohio, in 1856–1863.

mather-cases-of-conscience-1693-english.title: Cases of Conscience Concerning Evil Spirits Personating Men
mather-cases-of-conscience-1693-english.creator: Increase Mather
mather-cases-of-conscience-1693-english.description: Increase Mather's 1693 Cases of Conscience — 'better ten suspected witches escape than one innocent be condemned': the prosecutorial brake that helped end the Salem trials, issued as the court's own ministerial guidance.

pmc-10731039.title: Anomalous papillary muscle insertion into the mitral valve leaflet in hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy: a lip nevus sign in echocardiography
pmc-10731039.creator: Jian Liu, Tong Tan, Peijian Wei, Jianrui Ma, Lishan Zhong, Hailong Qiu, Shengwen Wang, Jian Zhuang, Wei Zhu, Huiming Guo, Jimei Chen
pmc-10731039.description: BackgroundAnomalous papillary muscle (APM) insertion into the mitral valve leaflet is rare but clinically important in hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM). In this study, we report the detection rate of APM insertion into the mitral valve using preoperative imaging modalities and the surgical outcomes of the patients.

pmc-11477510.title: Could the Adoptive Transfer of Memory Lymphocytes be an Alternative Treatment for Acinetobacter baumannii Infections?
pmc-11477510.creator: Tania Cebrero-Cangueiro, Soraya Herrera-Espejo, María Paniagua, Gema Labrador-Herrera, José Miguel Cisneros, Jerónimo Pachón, María Eugenia Pachón-Ibáñez
pmc-11477510.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We evaluated the efficacy of the adoptive transfer of memory B, CD4+, and CD8+ T lymphocytes compared with sulbactam and tigecycline in an experimental murine pneumonia model by two multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii strains, colistin-susceptible AbCS01 and colistin-resistant AbCR17. Pharmacodynamically optimized antimicrobial dosages were administered for 72 h, and intravenous administration of 2 × 106 of each of the memory cells in a single dose 30 min post-infection. Bacterial lung and blood counts and mortality rates were analyzed.

pmc-11510697.title: Impact of Bifidobacterium longum Subspecies infantis on Pediatric Gut Health and Nutrition: Current Evidence and Future Directions
pmc-11510697.creator: Vanessa Nadia Dargenio, Fernanda Cristofori, Viviana Fara Brindicci, Federico Schettini, Costantino Dargenio, Stefania Paola Castellaneta, Andrea Iannone, Ruggiero Francavilla, Blessing J Akombi-Inyang
pmc-11510697.description: Background: the intestinal microbiota, a complex community vital to human health, is shaped by microbial competition and host-driven selective pressures. Among these microbes, Bifidobacterium plays a crucial role in early gut colonization during neonatal stages, where Bifidobacterium longum subspecies infantis (B. infantis) predominates and is particularly prevalent in healthy breastfed infants.

pmc-11532266.title: Spread of the meningococci group C isolates of the clonal complex 10217 beyond the African meningitis belt
pmc-11532266.creator: Selma Bouheraoua, Ala-Eddine Deghmane, Rym Laliam, Badia Guettou, Fatiha Djedjig, Meriem Djemaa, Youcef Sellami, Mohamed Yousfi, FZohra Aissat, Nassima Achour, Sadjia Mahrane, Muhamed-Kheir Taha, Hassiba Tali Maamar
pmc-11532266.description: Highlights•Serogroup C invasive meningococcal disease is rare in Algeria.•Serogroup C invasive meningococcal disease is frequent in sub-Saharan Africa.•Serogroup C isolates in sub-Saharan Africa belong to the clonal complex 10217.•These isolates are recently reported in Algeria among migrants and autochthones.•Enhanced molecular surveillance is important to track the spread of these isolates.

pmc-11727640.title: Sitting Acquisition and Early Communication Development: Are There Associations in Very Preterm Infants at Six Months of Corrected Age?
pmc-11727640.creator: Valentina Graziosi, Chiara Suttora, Cecilia Gorini, Mariagrazia Zuccarini, Caterina Verganti, Arianna Aceti, Isadora Beghetti, Luigi Corvaglia, Annalisa Guarini, Alessandra Sansavini, Mark Dzietko
pmc-11727640.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Research in typically and some atypically developing populations showed associations between early motor and communication development, documenting how postural development can support communicative advancements. However, these relations have scarcely been investigated in the preterm population. Aims: The present study aimed to describe motor (gross and fine motor) and communication (receptive and expressive) skills of very preterm infants at six months of corrected age and their associations, focusing on sitting posture achievement and early vocal production.

pmc-12399888.title: The Role of CELMoD Agents in Multiple Myeloma
pmc-12399888.creator: Niels W C J van de Donk, Nizar J Bahlis, Charlotte Pawlyn, Francesca Gay, Maria-Victoria Mateos, Katja Weisel, Sagar Lonial, Paul G Richardson
pmc-12399888.description: Although recent decades have seen continued improvements in survival for patients with multiple myeloma, the disease remains largely incurable, and most patients will experience relapse and/or become refractory to treatment. There thus remains an urgent unmet need for novel treatments, particularly for those patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

pmc-12494932.title: Dose optimization and utilization trends of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists in heart failure patients with reduced ejection fraction in Ethiopia
pmc-12494932.creator: Minimize Hassen, Birhane Tilahun Worku, Tewodros Solomon, Mulat Belete Demessie, Teklehaimanot Fentie Wendie, Oumer Sada Muhammed, Mengistie Yirsaw Gobezie
pmc-12494932.description: BackgroundNascent evidence-based guidelines advocate the use of Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists (MRAs) in all heart failure patients with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) to abridge cardiovascular mortality and morbidity. This study assessed the utilization patterns and dose optimization of MRAs among patients with HFrEF at Dessie Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia, from March to August 2024.

pmc-12664274.title: Health behaviors to prevent cardiovascular risk: a systematic review
pmc-12664274.creator: Nsabimana Mick, Léon G Blaise Savadogo, Niyongabo Théodore
pmc-12664274.description: BackgroundA low level of health literacy contributes to the increasing prevalence of cardiovascular diseases in Africa. In addition, the management of cardiovascular diseases is hampered by poor access to quality healthcare hence the importance of primary prevention.The aim of this literature review was to identify good health behaviors to be adopted by individuals to prevent the onset of cardiovascular disease.

pmc-13156521.title: Achieving 27.7% Efficiency with a Mechanically Stacked, Four‐Terminal Perovskite/InGaAsP Tandem Solar Cell
pmc-13156521.creator: Bikesh Gupta, The Duong, Tuomas Haggren, Daniel Walter, Julie Tournet, Azul Osorio Mayon, Chennupati Jagadish, Hark Hoe Tan, Siva Karuturi
pmc-13156521.description: Multijunction solar cell architectures offer a means to exceed the efficiency limits of traditional single‐junction cells, notably surpassing the Shockley–Queisser limit. III–V compound semiconductors, known for their adaptable bandgaps, are often used in constructing multijunction cells, but their fabrication largely relies on complex epitaxial growth techniques. These processes are further complicated by the demanding necessity for lattice‐matched, heavily‐doped tunnel junctions.

pmc-13278025.title: Hippocampal Glutamatergic Hyperactivation Mediates High‐Loading Intensity of Exercise‐Induced Cognitive Deficits Via HPC‐mPFC Circuit Dysfunction
pmc-13278025.creator: Qian Bai, Le Wang, Hedong Lang, Hongtao Yu, Xiaolei Wang, Jian Wang, Jundong Zhu, Ka Chen, Mantian Mi
pmc-13278025.description: AimsExcessive exercise impairs cognition and elevates late‐life cognitive risk. However, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigates the neural mechanisms through which high‐intensity endurance exercise induces cognitive deficits.MethodsMice underwent high‐loading intensity exercise (HLIE) with a 7‐day treadmill procedure (25 m/min, 90 min/day).

pmc-13354275.title: Gastrointestinal manifestations during oral immunotherapy: A guide for pediatric allergists
pmc-13354275.creator: Martina Votto, Roberta Olcese, Maria De Filippo, Lucia Caminiti, Francesco Catamerò, Filippo Favuzza, Simone Foti Randazzese, Massimo Landi, Gian Luigi Marseglia, Michele Miraglia Del Giudice, Mattia Giovannini, Salvatore Barberi
pmc-13354275.description: Oral immunotherapy (OIT) is a promising therapeutic strategy for desensitizing patients with immunoglobulin E (IgE)‐mediated food allergies. Although effective, OIT is frequently associated with adverse events (AEs), and gastrointestinal (GI) manifestations are among the most common and challenging AEs, which are the leading cause of OIT discontinuation.

pmc-13511775.title: Effects of Myofibrillar Protein-Stabilized Soybean Oil Pre-Emulsions Containing Arabic Gum or Gallic Acid-Grafted Arabic Gum on the Quality Characteristics and Oxidative Stability of Reduced-Animal-Fat Emulsified Sausages
pmc-13511775.creator: Chang Liu, Mingze Xu, Yi Luan, Khubaib Ali, Rui Sun, Qingling Wang, Shixue Wu, Yixue Shi, Mangang Wu
pmc-13511775.description: Soybean oil-based pre-emulsions stabilized by myofibrillar protein (MP), Arabic gum (AG), or gallic acid-grafted Arabic gum (GA-AG) were used to partially (50%) or fully (100%) replace pork back fat in Western-style emulsified sausages. The present study investigated the effects of such replacement on the initial quality attributes and lipid oxidation stability of sausages during storage.

pmc-13558303.title: Clinical characteristics and temporal trends of pediatric gastrointestinal foreign body ingestion: a single-center retrospective study
pmc-13558303.creator: Yuta Takeuchi, Seiichiro Inoue, Yuki Muta, Akio Odaka
pmc-13558303.description: PurposeWe aimed to evaluate temporal changes in the clinical characteristics and management of pediatric gastrointestinal foreign body ingestion.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed patients aged < 15 years who presented with suspected foreign body ingestion between January 2016 and June 2025. Patients were divided into early (≤ 2020) and late (≥ 2021) periods.

pmc-13662949.title: Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses reveal host–metabolite interactions underlying cloacal inflammation in laying Pekin ducks
pmc-13662949.creator: Yaxi Xu, Wentao Cai, Qinglei Yang, Zhenlin Liu, Xihui Sheng, Shuisheng Hou, Jian Hu
pmc-13662949.description: ObjectiveCloacal inflammation in laying ducks, often accompanied by prolapse, is a major threat to animal welfare, productivity, and intestinal health. However, the underlying molecular and metabolic mechanisms remain largely unclear.MethodsCloacal tissues and contents from inflamed and healthy laying Pekin ducks were examined histologically, transcriptomically, and metabolomically. Cross-omics integration was used to identify coordinated molecular and metabolic changes.
